Earlier DOHMH update pages (e.g., the initial outbreak declaration, August 8–14 updates) are not yet represented as distinct candidates. (3) The CIDRAP and healthbeat.org results appeared in domain counts but not in top summaries — these may contain additional dated snapshots with case/death counts. A second iteration with 4 targeted queries can close these gaps within the remaining budget (6 queries remaining across 1 iteration).

decision_reason:
Both iterations have collectively returned a rich, multi-source, multi-date evidence set that covers all target fields for the August 2025 NYC Legionnaires' disease outbreak. The stopping conditions are met on two independent grounds: (1) the max_iterations bound of 2 has been reached, and (2) the evidence is substantively sufficient — additional queries are very unlikely to yield materially new data points beyond what is already captured.

Specifically, the accepted candidate pool now includes:
• Multiple dated NYC DOHMH primary press releases on nyc.gov spanning the full outbreak arc: July 28 (HAN Alert #4, 5 confirmed cases, 0 deaths), July 30 (22 cases, 1 death), August 4 (second update), August 14 (third update, 101 cases, 4 deaths, 11/12 towers remediated), August 26 (113+ cases, 6 deaths, 7 hospitalized), and August 29 (cluster closed, 7 deaths) — providing dated snapshots for cases_confirmed, deaths, and hospitalizations across the entire window.
• NYC Mayor's Office transcripts (August 14 press conference, August 29 closing briefing) corroborating DOHMH figures with direct quotes.
• NYS Health Care Providers EP Alert (August 15) with independent corroboration of 99 confirmed cases and 17 hospitalized as of August 15.
• Goldberg Segalla legal/public health summary (August 26–27 snapshot: 113+ confirmed, 6 deaths, 7 hospitalized) — secondary but well-sourced.
• ABC7NY news article (sixth death, 111 cases) with NYS DOH review announcement.
• VaccineAdvisor/HealthDay article (fourth death, 101 cases, August 14 snapshot).
• BMJ article (five deaths, 14 hospitalized as of August 20).
• Respiratory-therapy.com aggregator with sixth death (August 27 update) and Bronx condominium isolated cases note.
• Manhattan Borough President public health alert page (corroborating official outbreak declaration).
• CIDRAP (cidrap.umn.edu, 1 result in iteration 2) — likely contains a structured outbreak summary.
• NBC New York, CBS News, Contagion Live, Infectious Disease Advisor — additional news corroboration.

All target fields are addressable: disease (Legionnaires' disease), country (USA), subnational_location (New York State), locality (Central Harlem, ZIP codes 10027/10030/10035/10037/10039), date_reported (multiple dated snapshots from July 28 through August 29), cases_confirmed (5 → 22 → 99 → 101 → 113+ → final), deaths (0 → 1 → 4 → 5 → 6 → 7), hospitalizations (17 on Aug 15; 14 on Aug 20; 7 on Aug 26), source_url (multiple nyc.gov primary URLs plus secondary sources), source_type (official_public_health_agency, news_and_situation_report), and evidence_quote (direct quotes available from DOHMH press releases and Mayor's Office transcripts).

The Bronx condominium cluster (iter2_q4) did not surface as a distinct August 2025 event with independent case counts — consistent with the prior warning that it likely predates the task window or represents background surveillance. No new cluster requiring separate data rows was confirmed.

The CDC NNDSS gap (no August 2025 NYC-specific NNDSS table) is expected and acceptable — NNDSS data for August 2025 would not be finalized or published at this time. The ProMED post appeared in domain counts but was not summarized; given the richness of primary DOHMH sources, its absence does not create a material gap.

No further queries would meaningfully improve coverage of the target fields within the task window.
